title: Ten-company $145M NAVFAC petroleum/oil/lubricants multiple-award contract
why: A second multi-award pool, worded completely differently from the Army one -- 'were awarded a combined $145,000,000 ... multiple award contract' instead of 'will compete for each order of'. A rule tuned to the Army phrasing must still get this one right, and small-business status differs company by company inside the pool.
verified_against: the announcement prose, by hand. Not verified against any model output -- cache/llm/ is empty.

checks.quote: AECOM Technical Services Inc., Los Angeles, California (N39430-26-D-2011); Aptim Federal Services LLC, Baton Rouge, Louisiana (N39430-26-D-2012); Argus Consulting Inc.,* Overland Park, Kansas (N39430-26-D-2013); Austin Brockenbrough & Associates LLC, Richmond, Virginia (N39430-26-D-2014); Burns & McDonnell Engineering Co. Inc., Kansas City, Missouri (N39430-26-D-2015); Enterprise Engineering Inc.,* Anchorage, Alaska (N39430-26-D-2016); HDR Engineering Inc., Omaha, Nebraska (N39430-26-D-2017); Pond & Co., Peachtree Corners, Georgia (N39430-26-D-2018); Robert and Co. Inc.,* Atlanta, Georgia (N39430-26-D-2019); and Tetra Tech Inc., Collinsville, Illinois (N39430-26-D-2020), were awarded a combined $145,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award contract.
checks.reason: Ten company names, ten contract numbers, one paragraph. The text confirms the count itself: 'The maximum dollar value for all 10 contracts is $145,000,000'.

checks.quote: were awarded a combined $145,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award contract. ... The maximum dollar value for all 10 contracts is $145,000,000 over a five-year base period.
checks.reason: $145,000,000 is explicitly the total for all ten contracts, so it is the shared ceiling repeated on every row -- not $14.5M each, and not the $10,000 per-awardee minimum guarantee.

checks.quote: AECOM Technical Services Inc., Los Angeles, California (N39430-26-D-2011); ... were awarded a combined $145,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award contract. ... This contract was competitively procured via the SAM.gov website, with 14 offers received.
checks.reason: No asterisk on AECOM -> small_business false. The paragraph says indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity in so many words -> is_idiq true. 14 offers received, solicited count not stated -> null.

checks.quote: Argus Consulting Inc.,* Overland Park, Kansas (N39430-26-D-2013)
checks.reason: Small-business status is per company inside a pool: Argus carries the asterisk, AECOM does not. A rule that sets small_business for the whole paragraph fails here.

checks.quote: and Tetra Tech Inc., Collinsville, Illinois (N39430-26-D-2020), were awarded a combined $145,000,000 firm-fixed-price, indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, multiple award contract.
checks.reason: The tenth awardee sits directly against the shared verb phrase and is the one most likely to be dropped or merged.

checks.quote: Fiscal 2026 Navy working capital funds in the amount of $10,000 per awardee will be obligated at time of award to satisfy the minimum guarantee.
checks.reason: An obligation/minimum-guarantee figure is never amount_usd.
